explication: Orca is a cross-platform AI-agent orchestration desktop app with a mobile companion. The main workflow is to start agents in isolated worktrees, run them in terminals, and inspect or annotate their changes; mobile monitoring and CLI automation provide alternate control surfaces. The README documents product capabilities beyond the sampled implementation, so those branches use exact enclosing paths from the tree. Source excerpts confirm mobile and Markdown review behavior, but do not establish every runtime connection.
